items.title: 68098_Snub Mosley oral history interview
items.q: I had no trouble with her and we had a rough tour. She did her work.

ctx.x: She's done a lot of USO.

They asked me if it was all right and I said of course. She was much older than the girls that I had, but that was all right with me. I had no trouble with her and we had a rough tour. She did her work.

items.title: 68436_Alberta Hunter oral history interview
